name: app-test-multiagent-brain-extraction
summary: Skull-strips a T1-weighted image with FSL BET (test App) and outputs the brain-extracted T1w.
description: Test App that wraps FSL bet with the fractional intensity threshold (-f), robust centre estimation (-R) and bias-field/neck cleanup (-B) options. As registered it is unlikely to run: the t1 input has no config key and the wrapper expects config keys t1 and brain_extracted. Prefer an established brain-extraction App for real data.

outputs.description: Brain-extracted T1-weighted image produced by BET.

parameters.description: BET fractional intensity threshold (0-1); smaller values give larger brain estimates.
Use BET's robust brain centre estimation (-R).
Apply BET bias-field and neck cleanup (-B).
